h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Guntur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Guntur

items.pText: Guntur is known for its chilli market and for its many schools, colleges and coaching centres. Several schools here have large enrolments on compact campuses, and fitting enough play into that space is the problem we are most often asked to solve. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 870 km from Guntur, and delivers it by road.

When several sections of one class come out for a play period together, a single slide and two swings do not go far. The answer is to spread activities across the ground and to plan play periods by class. We look at how many children will be outside at one time and then suggest a mix that keeps most of them busy. Guntur is hot and humid for much of the year, so we build with galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning for many children on one ground

c: Count the children who will be out at the same moment, rather than the total strength of the school. Then choose equipment that holds several at once: a multi play station with two or three slides, a double swing set, a multi-seat see-saw and a climbing net. Spread these around the ground so queues do not form at one point. Many schools also stagger play periods, with junior classes on the equipment in the morning and seniors later.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 870 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How much equipment does a large school need?
items.a: That depends on how many children play at the same time. Tell us the largest group that comes out together and the size of the ground, and we will suggest a mix that spreads them across several pieces.

items.q: Can junior and senior classes share one play area?
items.a: They can share a ground if each age group has its own zone. We place low equipment for junior classes apart from taller structures for older children and mark both zones on the drawing.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Guntur?
items.a: Yes. Orders travel from our Vasai factory to Guntur by road. Our installation team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs them using the method that suits your ground.
